purpose: Materialize the first nonzero national point-in-time eligible feature slice using only the domains whose known-at authority the BAT-666 audit actually established. Every prior-derived value is recomputed from bound-admissible evidence rather than inherited from the existing spine, so the slice is eligible by construction rather than by assertion.

excluded_domains.reason: The BAT-666 audit found no observed publication instant on either national route, so poll values have retrieval-time authority only.
The mutable dome and playing-surface attributes have retrieval-time authority only, and the audit rejected inheriting the geographic time-invariant basis for them.

eligibility_rules.cutoff_rule: A prior contest contributes to a target row only when its precommitted completion bound does not exceed the target contest's earliest possible start.
eligibility_rules.same_game_exclusion: A contest can never be its own prior, because its completion bound always exceeds its own earliest possible start.
eligibility_rules.future_append_invariance: A target row's emitted values depend only on contests whose completion bound precedes that target, so appending later contests cannot change an already-emitted row.
eligibility_rules.tie_handling: A tie counts toward games played and toward neither wins nor losses.

row_verdicts.PIT_FEATURE_ELIGIBLE: The row carries at least one bound-admissible prior value and every emitted value is determined by evidence provably knowable before the contest began.
row_verdicts.PIT_ELIGIBLE_NO_PRIOR_INFORMATION: The row is temporally sound but has no bound-admissible prior, so every prior feature is truthfully missing and the row carries no prior information.
row_verdicts.REJECTED_NO_USABLE_START_EVIDENCE: The target contest carries no parseable start evidence, so no cutoff can be computed and the row is rejected.
row_verdicts.REJECTED_NO_OUTCOME_REFERENCE: The target team-game has no outcome-label row, so its membership in the national population cannot be confirmed.
row_verdicts.REJECTED_SEALED_SEASON: The row belongs to a sealed season and must never enter any slice.

leakage_exposure_measurement.purpose: Quantify how much of the existing spine's prior evidence was not provably knowable before kickoff, by comparing the recomputed bound-admissible prior count against the spine's own prior count.
leakage_exposure_measurement.expectation: The recomputed count must never exceed the spine count, because the bound only ever removes priors.
